hotels.title: French Riviera Beachfront Cannes Escape at Pullman Mandelieu
hotels.description: Overlooking the Bay of Cannes on the edge of Mandelieu-La Napoule, this polished retreat pairs Riviera glamour with direct access to a private beach and the Old Course Cannes Mandelieu golf course. Palm-fringed pools, a spa and Mediterranean dining set the scene between swims in the sea and afternoons on the fairways. Beyond the hotel, stroll to Château de la Napoule for seaside gardens and art-filled halls, or follow the marina towards waterside tables serving Provençal seafood. Cannes’ Croisette, designer boutiques and the Marché Forville are within easy reach along the coast
